subject: biology-1
question: A sprinter's leg muscles demand large amounts of ATP during a race. Why must these cells contain many **mitochondria**?

options.text: Mitochondria digest waste products so the muscle cell stays clean.
Mitochondria store the genetic information of the cell.
Mitochondria package proteins for export to the blood.
Mitochondria make ATP through cellular respiration.

explanation: Mitochondria carry out cellular respiration, converting chemical energy from food into ATP, and cells with high ATP demand contain many mitochondria. A fails because digesting waste is lysosome work. B fails because the nucleus stores most of the cell's genetic information. C fails because packaging proteins for export is the Golgi apparatus's job.
